suhtahlam.caregiverSystemSub: SUH TAH LAM · Performance & Adaptive System
suhtahlam.startInstructions: Take a peaceful breath. You will watch a short traditional bamboo activity. Take your time to observe the dancers and the rhythm of the bamboo poles.
suhtahlam.watchCarefullySub: Observe the dancer and the rhythm of the bamboo.
suhtahlam.praise1: Well done! You observed the rhythm with wonderful focus.
suhtahlam.praise2: Good remembering! Your calm attention is a true gift.
suhtahlam.praise3: Thank you for watching carefully. Let us continue gently.

dhopkhel.title: Dhopkhel Memory
dhopkhel.subtitle: A Gentle Memory Game
dhopkhel.shortDisclaimer: Cognitive memory-support practice. Not a medical diagnostic tool or treatment.
dhopkhel.gameCompleteSub: You completed all levels of Dhopkhel Memory with fantastic focus!
dhopkhel.selectDifficultySub: Choose the pace that feels most comfortable:
dhopkhel.levelEasyDesc: A very gentle sequence with generous observation time. No rush.
dhopkhel.levelMediumDesc: A few more passes to practice short-term recall. Still slow and steady.
dhopkhel.levelHardDesc: More passes for a deeper memory exercise. Speed stays calm and comfortable.
dhopkhel.step1Desc: The red cloth ball will slowly move between the three players.
dhopkhel.step2Desc: Notice which player holds the Dhop when the passes finish.
dhopkhel.step3Desc: The Dhop will hide. Choose Player 1, Player 2, or Player 3.
dhopkhel.recallSubtitle: Tap the player who was holding the ball:
dhopkhel.feedbackCorrectSub: Great memory! You tracked the Dhop perfectly.
dhopkhel.feedbackIncorrectSub: Let's try again! %{player} was holding the Dhop.
dhopkhel.voiceInstructions: Watch the ball carefully. Remember who has the Dhop.
dhopkhel.aboutText: Dhopkhel is a cherished traditional ball game from Assam, traditionally played with a soft woven ball called a 'Dhop'. This digital adaptation preserves the calm visual tracking and attention element for cognitive engagement and memory wellness.
dhopkhel.medicalDisclaimerText: "This game is designed for cognitive engagement and memory practice. It is not a medical diagnostic tool or treatment for dementia."

dhopkhel.accessibilitySetButtonExtraLarge: Set button size to Extra Large
dhopkhel.accessibilitySetSpeedSlow: Set animation speed to Slow and gentle
dhopkhel.accessibilitySaveReturn: Save and return to welcome screen

memoryStories.title: Xuworoni Kotha
memoryStories.storyParagraph1: On a sunny morning, Maya wore her favorite blue scarf and walked to the local market. She carried a small cloth bag in her hand.
memoryStories.storyParagraph2: At the fruit stall, Maya bought four sweet red apples. Near the flower shop, she met her kind neighbor, Sunita, and they shared a warm greeting. After their lovely chat, Maya walked back to her cozy home to rest.
memoryStories.readStoryPrompt: Read this calm story carefully. When you are ready, tap below to start answering questions.
memoryStories.correctSub: Wonderful memory! You got it right.
memoryStories.incorrectSub: Take your time. Pick the best answer.
memoryStories.unlockedMediumSub: You answered all 4 Easy questions correctly! Medium difficulty is now unlocked.
memoryStories.unlockedHardSub: You answered all 3 Medium questions correctly! Hard difficulty is now unlocked.
memoryStories.completionSub: Congratulations! You remembered all the story details wonderfully.
memoryStories.lockedLevelMessage: Complete %{prevLevel} questions to unlock this level.

q1.explanation: Maya went to the local market.

q2.explanation: Maya bought sweet red apples at the fruit stall.

q3.explanation: Maya met her kind neighbor Sunita.

q4.text: Where did Maya return after shopping?
q4.explanation: Maya walked back to her cozy home to rest.
